import csv
tid='a39e93e1-f68f-5e9e-b836-56293fd89fa7'
vals={}
day=[]
for row in csv.DictReader(open(VALUES_CSV)):
    if row['timeseries_id']==tid:
        v=float(row['value'])
        vals[row['timestamp']]=v
        if row['timestamp'].startswith('2018-07-27'):
            day.append((row['timestamp'],v))
maxv=max(vals.values())
thr=0.9*maxv
print('max',maxv,'thr',thr)
print('day count',len(day))
allok=all(v<thr for t,v in day)
print(allok)
print([ (t,v) for t,v in day if v>=thr])
